articles.title: Coco Gauff Wins Big Before US Open!
articles.summary: Coco Gauff beat Jessica Pegula to win the Cincinnati Open, her first title of 2026. She's ready for the US Open!

articles.title: Swimming Star Leon Marchand Wants New Challenges
articles.summary: Olympic champ Leon Marchand is thinking about racing the 200m and 400m freestyle at the 2028 LA Olympics. He says he's found his 'thing'!

articles.title: I Watched Birds Grow Up in My Backyard—You Can Too!
articles.summary: A smart nest box with cameras lets you watch baby birds hatch and grow. One reviewer saw chickadees lay eggs, feed babies, and even hiss!
